summary: Frontend-only verification of the new persistent L: On/Off Live Stream toggle in Admin → DJ Control tab. All 6 acceptance criteria pass: toggle renders unconditionally with data-testid='dj-live-toggle-{id}', old dj-force-end-live-{id} testid is gone (count=0), button order in every on-shift row is L→K→Out, LIVE state shows 'L: On' with red bg-red-600 and is enabled, clicking (with confirm accepted) fires POST /api/livekit/stream/stop (200) and after refresh the same toggle shows 'L: Off' with text-slate-500 grey styling and is disabled (button.disabled=true, is_disabled()=True). Clicking the disabled OFF toggle does NOT fire /api/livekit/stream/stop. Regression: dj-toggle-karaoke-{id}, dj-checkout-{id}, emergency-broadcast-card and homepage-modules-card all still render correctly and above the On Shift section.
critical_code_review_comments: DJControlTab.jsx line 405 title tooltip still reads 'Stop live stream' when not live even though the button is disabled; consider updating the disabled-state title to something like 'DJ must start stream from their panel' only (currently the ternary handles it correctly — verified). No change needed.
forceEndLive() uses window.confirm which blocks Playwright test automation unless dialog handler is registered — not a bug, but note that automated E2E for this button must accept the dialog.
seed_data_creation: Used DJ MIKE (id 57cae364-b31f-4920-909f-fda18fc78fe6). Checked in at edgewood-atlanta, started livekit stream, verified LIVE state; stopped stream via UI toggle click; verified OFF/disabled state. Cleaned up: stream stopped and DJ checked out.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_66 verified the L: On/Off toggle. Behavior fully matches spec. Confirm dialog fires on the 'L: On' click (window.confirm in forceEndLive). No open bugs from this iteration.
